blocks.html:
This method retrieves a workflow execution by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Workflow Execution](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#workflows-executions\_getworkflowsexecutionsworkflow\_idtransaction\_id)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the workflow execution to retrieve.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the workflow execution.

children.name: execution
children.description: The execution details of the workflow.

children.name: context
children.description:
The context of the workflow execution.
This includes the data, errors and the output of the step and compensation functions of the workflow execution.

children.name: state
children.description: The state of the workflow execution.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was updated.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the workflow execution was deleted.
